changes: NOTHING WAS CHANGED. This is not a transcription: the manufacturer serves this model as a text file, so it was frozen byte-for-byte under vendor/ and the whole file - model text and the vendor's own comment blocks - was appended below a header of our own. No parameter was removed (unlike models/jfet/lsk489.lib and models/bjt_pnp/ls350.lib, where mfg= had to be stripped because ngspice evaluates it as an expression and dies; this file has no mfg=), no value was rounded, reordered or 'corrected', and the model NAME was left exactly as served. Verifiable rather than asserted: diff <(grep -v '^\*' <vendor file>) <(grep -v '^\*' <this file>) is empty. One consequence worth knowing: the vendor file uses CRLF and our header uses LF, so the assembled file has MIXED line endings. That is deliberate - normalising the whole file rewrites the vendor bytes and breaks the diff above, silently. It happened once during L25 and only the diff caught it.
reason: T7 (ADR-016) requires a manufacturer SPICE model for every active device in the signal path, and NC-017 stays blocking until models/ actually carries them. This is the VAS transistor of the gain block (circuits/preamp/gain_block.py:316), which with its 470 pF Miller capacitor sets the dominant pole of the whole amplifier. ADR-017 keeps the 2N5401 die and changes manufacturer and package - MMBT5401, Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23 - because a genuinely different transistor there would move a figure the topology is built on.
notes: CROSS-CHECK AGAINST THE VENDOR'S OWN DATASHEET (DS30057 Rev. 12-2, 2024), measured with ngspice 47 at the datasheet's conditions, set temp = 25: hFE 124.917 at IC = -10 mA, VCE = -5 V (window 60..240, INSIDE); fT 160.116 MHz at IC = -10 mA, VCE = -10 V, ftest = 100 MHz (100 MHz min, INSIDE); C_obo 3.7063 pF at VCB = -10 V, 1 MHz, IE = 0 (6 pF max, INSIDE). THREE OF THREE INSIDE - with the MMBT5551, the only model in this repo with no mixed verdict. THE fT FIGURE CORRECTS L24, which recorded 169.5 MHz. The difference is the operating point, not the model: L24's number is reproduced exactly by driving a round IB = 100 uA, which this model turns into IC = 12.68 mA, 27% above the current the datasheet specifies fT at. Re-measured in L25 with IC verified at 10.000 mA the answer is 160.1 MHz on three agreeing legs (ftest definition 160.116, |hfe| = 1 crossing 160.084, GBW at 50 MHz 160.098). The verdict is unchanged; the number moves by -5.5%. PSPICE QUASI-SATURATION PARAMETERS: QUASIMOD, RCO and GAMMA are accepted by ngspice 47 with zero warnings - re-verified by running it in L25, not inherited. That silence means something only because on lsk489.lib the same ngspice prints four 'unrecognized parameter ... ignored' lines. NO KF/AF, therefore NO 1/f noise - in this repo only models/jfet/lsk489.lib has flicker noise, which is why NC-004 does not close when the real models arrive. Any noise figure computed with this device is a floor without flicker and must say so next to the number.
